# a9l.im

Portfolio and project hub at **[a9l.im](https://a9l.im)**. A single-page app with a dense personal homepage, project grids, and a markdown blog, plus eight browser projects mounted as git submodules. The resume is a downloadable PDF (`/resume.pdf`). Vanilla JS, HTML, and CSS are served through Cloudflare Workers + Assets; `_build.mjs` compiles the hand-edited content and discovery surfaces before deployment.

## Projects

Eight interactive projects live on the site as submodules, alongside the external repositories listed in `content/projects/`.

## Shared Design System

This repo hosts a shared design system that all the subprojects consume via absolute paths (`/shared-tokens.js`, `/shared-base.css`, and so on). It includes design tokens, a CSS reset, utility functions, toolbar and form components, keyboard shortcuts, camera controls, tooltips, tabs, and touch gestures. Anything I change here affects every project.

## Run Locally

```bash
node _build.mjs
python -m http.server
# open http://localhost:8000
```

Use `./dev.sh` when Worker routing, SSR, CSP, or production headers matter. Run `node _build.mjs --check` and `node tests/content-pipeline/run.mjs` before committing content changes.
